articles.title: Breeds naturally inclined to guard backyard chickens identified by veterinarians
articles.summary: A surprising solution to protecting backyard chickens has emerged from experts in the field of animal care. According to veterinarians consulted by our team, certain dog breeds are...
articles.content: A surprising solution to protecting backyard chickens has emerged from experts in the field of animal care. According to veterinarians consulted by our team, certain dog breeds are naturally inclined to guard and protect these birds rather than chase them. The Great Pyrenees is one such breed, originally developed for guarding livestock. While its instincts may be sound, even a young puppy can unintentionally harm a chicken through overzealous play. Kathryn Dench, MRCVS, chief scientific advisor at Paw Origins, cautions that introducing these dogs to chickens requires careful planning and early training. Another breed known for guarding livestock is the Maremma sheepdog. With a long history of protecting other animals, this breed has been recommended by veterinarians as a potential candidate for homes with chickens. However, even in breeds naturally inclined to guard, proper socialization and training from an early age are crucial to prevent conflicts between dogs and birds. The Anatolian shepherd is yet another livestock guardian that may be suitable for chicken-keeping households. Bred to protect flocks from predators, this breed has been endorsed by both Dench and Nascimento as a consideration for families with backyard chickens. When it comes to determining whether a dog will protect or chase backyard chickens, livestock guardian heritage is not a guarantee in itself. The individual dog's behavior and temperament around birds must be carefully evaluated before making any conclusions. Golden retrievers are often considered a breed that can thrive in households with poultry due to their friendly nature and trainability. They respond well to instruction, which makes them more likely to learn that the backyard flock is off-limits. According to Dr. , a veterinarian and zoologist at Meowoff, golden retrievers may be suitable for families with small backyard flocks. This breed's characteristics suggest they could do well in environments where chickens are present. Labrador retrievers, another popular breed, were originally bred to retrieve game, including birds. However, their social nature and trainability make them worth considering for households with chickens. The Komondor breed has a storied history as a livestock guardian, tasked with protecting flocks from predators rather than hunting them. This instinctual background may make it a suitable match for households with backyard chickens, given its natural inclination to watch over and defend. Another potential candidate is the Polish Tatra sheepdog, a traditional guardian breed that was developed to live alongside livestock while keeping an eye out for threats. While not automatically safe around birds, this breed's temperament, prey drive, and behavior should be carefully considered when introducing it to a home with chickens. Ultimately, any dog brought into a household with backyard chickens requires careful attention to its individual personality and instincts to ensure harmonious coexistence between the two species. articles.content: United Airlines will operate a rare sighting of its most premium aircraft on a route that typically doesn't feature it. In January, the carrier will fly a brand-new Boeing 787-9 Dreamliner between Las Vegas and Tokyo, marking an unusual appearance for this luxurious plane. The Boeing 787-9 "Elevated Dreamliner boasts a next-generation interior, including Polaris Suites and spacious Polaris Studios. These premium features are usually reserved for routes to high-end destinations such as London, Singapore, and Seoul. The plane's design includes 99 premium seats. United has primarily used this luxurious aircraft on flights out of major hubs like San Francisco or Houston, where there is a higher demand for premium seating. However, the carrier will make an exception for the route between Las Vegas' Harry Reid International Airport (LAS) and Tokyo's Narita International Airport (NRT). The special appearance of the Boeing 787-9 Dreamliner on this route is due to the upcoming Consumer Electronics Show in Las Vegas, set to take place from January. The event draws a large crowd, and United is likely catering to the high-end travelers attending the conference by deploying its most premium aircraft on this route. As one of the biggest conventions in Las Vegas each year, the Consumer Electronics Show (CES) draws visitors from all over the world, making it a prime opportunity for airlines to offer special temporary routes and premium services. The Harry Reid International Airport (LAS) in Las Vegas will be abuzz with activity as United Airlines brings its nicest plane to the city. This is not an uncommon occurrence, as airlines often add special temporary routes around major events, sometimes deploying planes that fit the occasion. In recent years, carriers have been leaning more heavily into major sporting events, introducing new and unusual routes focused on college and professional football games. United has historically made a big splash at CES, with its premium services and aircraft catering to the high-end travelers attending the conference. Delta Air Lines is also getting in on the action, adding special routes centered around CES. The carrier will operate one-off services from Las Vegas to Hong Kong and Taipei, as well as extra daily flights during the event to its hubs and focus city, Austin. United's Elevated" 787 service from LAS to NRT will run on three days toward the tail-end of CES: January 6-8. This premium aircraft is likely a nod to the high-end travelers attending the conference, with amenities such as Polaris Studios. United Airlines has opted to deploy its premium-configured 787-9 aircraft for a unique route, one that typically wouldn't see such high-end service. This plane features an impressive array of amenities, including eight Polaris Studios and 56 standard Polaris business-class suites. The airline's choice of aircraft is notable given the destination, with flights from Tokyo to Las Vegas being operated by a different model altogether, specifically, the Boeing 777-200ER, on dates January 3, 4, and 5. The premium-configured 787-9 boasts a more extensive offering of business-class amenities than the standard configuration. This unusual deployment suggests that United is catering to high-end travelers attending a conference or event in Las Vegas. articles.title: The Twilight Zone Airs from 1959 to 1964
articles.summary: The series captivated audiences with its unique blend of science fiction and social commentary.
articles.content: The Twilight Zone took over television screens from 1959 to 1964, captivating audiences with its unique blend of science fiction and social commentary. The series, hosted by Rod Serling, transported viewers into a world where "a dimension of sound, a dimension of sight, a dimension of mind" merged with the ordinary reality of everyday life. The show's ability to balance science fiction with real-world issues made it a groundbreaking program at the time of its release. With 156 episodes spanning five seasons, The Twilight Zone tackled topics such as racism, war, and technology's impact on society in a way that was both thought-provoking and entertaining. Each episode presented new characters and plots, drawing viewers deeper into the series' surreal world. Just when audiences thought they understood the story, a sudden twist would turn everything upside down, often leading to a profound moral lesson. The show's use of supernatural elements added an air of mystery, keeping viewers on the edge of their seats as they tried to piece together the puzzle of what was happening. The series' impact extended beyond its own runtime, with many episodes influencing popular culture and inspiring new works of fiction. Today, The Twilight Zone remains a beloved classic, widely regarded for its innovative storytelling and exploration of complex themes. Rotten Tomatoes has ranked each season individually, revealing some surprising results among the five seasons that made up the series. While all seasons received generally positive reviews, there was significant variation in their scores on the Tomatometer. The overall ranking of The Twilight Zone on Rotten Tomatoes stands at 92%, a testament to its enduring influence and critical acclaim. However, not all seasons were created equal, with some scoring higher than others according to the review site's ratings. The first season of The Twilight Zone premiered in October 1959 and set the tone for the rest of the series with its captivating storyline. However, not all main characters were as memorable as the show's plots. Mike Ferris, the protagonist of the first episode, wandered into the small town of Oakwood without a clue about his identity or purpose. The eerie atmosphere and thought-provoking themes of the season immediately drew viewers in, making them question what was real and what was just a simulation. This blend of science fiction and mystery elements has become a hallmark of the series. Some standout episodes from Season 1 include "Mr. Denton on Doomsday, which explores the consequences of playing with fate, and The Four of Us Are Dying, a twisty tale about four strangers who find themselves trapped in a never-ending nightmare. Another highlight is The Fever, a gripping episode that delves into the psychological effects of a mysterious illness. Meanwhile, The Monsters Are Due on Maple Street taps into societal fears about conformity and the dangers of jumping to conclusions. Rotten Tomatoes gave Season 1 of The Twilight Zone its highest rating among all seasons, indicating widespread critical acclaim for this initial installment. The success of Season 1 laid the groundwork for future seasons, which would go on to tackle even more complex and thought-provoking themes. Rotten Tomatoes' perfect rating for Season 1 of The Twilight Zone set a high standard for future seasons to follow. Season 2 of the show also received a flawless score from Rotten Tomatoes, continuing the pattern established by its predecessor. The second season kicked off with King Nine Will Not Return, an episode that raised questions about the nature of reality. James Embry, a World War II pilot, is on a plane that crashes in the desert. When he regains consciousness, his crew is nowhere to be found. As Embry navigates the desert and experiences strange visions in the sky, he wakes up 17 years later, triggered by news headlines about the incident. This raises the possibility of either PTSD or supernatural occurrences in his hospital room. The season's remaining episodes continued to explore thought-provoking themes, including Eye of the Beholder, which examined societal pressures and conformity, and A Most Unusual Camera, a story about a man who discovers a mysterious camera that can take more than just photographs. Other notable episodes from Season 2 include A Penny for Your Thoughts, in which a woman's thoughts become reality, and Will the Real Martian Please Stand Up?, an episode that pokes fun at xenophobia. The season concluded with The Obsolete Man. The third season of The Twilight Zone kicked off with a thought-provoking episode about two enemy soldiers in an apocalyptic battle. Despite being on opposing sides, they were forced to work together to survive as they navigated a desolate Earth devoid of human life. This season's lineup featured a diverse range of episodes, including The Shelter, which explored the theme of nuclear warfare and its effects on individuals and society. The episode The Mirror presented a surreal tale about a man who discovers a mysterious mirror that shows him an alternate reality. Other standout episodes from this season included It's a Good Life, a haunting story about a small town under the control of a sadistic child, and To Serve Man, which featured a group of humans being led to their doom by an alien species. The episode Little Girl Lost was another notable entry, as it delved into the world of psychological horror. The season also included Nothing in the Dark, a gripping tale about a woman who shoots a man she believes is a burglar, only to discover he's actually a survivor from a nuclear blast. Another episode, The Changing of the Guard, explored the theme of social hierarchy and power dynamics through the lens of an alien society. Rotten Tomatoes gave this season a high rating of 90%, with critics praising its superb writing and exceptional storytelling. The Critics Consensus noted that despite some unevenness in structure, the season featured some of the finest half hours in the series' history. The fourth season of The Twilight Zone received a lower Tomatometer score compared to its predecessors, tying for last place at 86%. This decrease in critical acclaim is notable when considering the high standards set by previous seasons. The first episode of Season 4, In His Image, tells the story of Alan Talbot, a 35-year-old man struggling with violent impulses and memory loss. Alan's life takes a drastic turn when he discovers his true nature: an android suffering from a malfunction. As the episode unfolds, Alan is eventually deactivated by the scientist who created him, who then assumes his identity and even woos Alan's fiancée. Other episodes in Season 4 explore various themes, including Valley of the Shadow," "Printer's Devil," "On Thursday We Leave for Home," "No Time Like the Past," and "The Bard. These episodes demonstrate the versatility and depth of storytelling that The Twilight Zone was known for during its run. In contrast to the creative highs of Season 4, the fifth season of The Twilight Zone marked a return to form with In Praise of Pip, which premiered in 1963. The fifth season of The Twilight Zone returned to form after a slight dip in creative quality. This was evident in episodes like Nightmare at 20,000 Feet" and "Living Doll, which were well-received by audiences. However, some critics pointed out that certain episodes were marred by clichés. Despite this, the season as a whole received an impressive 86% on Rotten Tomatoes, tying with Season 4 for last place in terms of overall ranking. The season featured a diverse range of storylines, including The Old Man in the Cave, which explored themes of survival and leadership. Other notable episodes included Ninety Years Without Slumbering" and "The Masks. The season's success was largely due to its ability to balance complex ideas with engaging storytelling. The episode In Praise of Pip stood out for its poignant portrayal of a father's love, while The Bewitchin' Pool" offered a thought-provoking commentary on the consequences of human actions. articles.title: Maison Lineti Develops Unconventional Whisky Production Methods
articles.summary: A French company has boldly deviated from traditional whisky production methods by using wine-science techniques in its fermentation, distillation, and maturation process.
articles.content: A French company has boldly deviated from traditional whisky production methods by using wine-science techniques in its fermentation, distillation, and maturation process. Maison Lineti, located in a region far removed from Scotland and Ireland's famous whisky-making districts, is shaking up the industry with its innovative approach. The company's use of wine-science methods has sparked widespread interest among experts, who are eager to learn more about this pioneering spirit. The result of Maison Lineti's unconventional techniques is a whisky that boasts an exceptionally floral, fresh, mineral, and textured character. This unique flavor profile has left industry insiders abuzz, with many praising the company's ability to produce exceptional-tasting spirits at a faster rate than traditional methods allow. The masterminds behind this groundbreaking approach are Magali Picard, a chemical engineer with a doctorate in oenology from the University of Bordeaux, and her partner Alex Cosculluela. The duo has been joined by Xavier Payan, who shares their passion for whisky-making and wine management expertise. Their company, launched in 2018, has gained significant attention after hosting the prestigious World Whisky Forum in June 2025. Industry insiders are eager to learn more about Maison Lineti's techniques and how they plan to disrupt traditional whisky production methods forever. The innovative approach to whisky production by Maison Lineti has been closely monitored by industry insiders eager to learn from their techniques. Picard's experiments were documented online as an open logbook, allowing observers to track her progress and note any significant developments. According to Picard and Cosculluela, the key factor in determining a great spirit is not age but rather the quality of the fermentation process. The traditional focus on cask style has been set aside by Maison Lineti in favor of concentrating on the steps leading up to maturation. In their pursuit of quality over quantity, they have experimented with techniques borrowed from the wine industry. The fermentation process at Maison Lineti is a unique blend of science and tradition, taking place within the confines of their "egg box. This remarkable space houses seven giant concrete, egg-shaped fermenters that stretch up to the ceiling, each one carefully designed for precise temperature control. The use of concrete in these fermenters has proven to be a game-changer, allowing for more accurate control over temperature fluctuations than traditional stainless steel containers. This attention to detail is crucial during fermentation, where even slight variations can impact the final flavor profile of the whisky. Another innovative aspect of Maison Lineti's approach is the absence of internal ridges within their concrete fermenters. This design choice enables smoother movement and churning of the liquid as the yeast ferments, potentially leading to a more complex and nuanced flavor experience. The extended pre-maturation period at Maison Lineti has yielded significant benefits for the distillers. By allowing the whisky to mature for several weeks longer than usual before transferring it to barrels, they can skip up to two years of traditional barrel aging. This not only reduces the overall time required but also results in a more efficient use of resources. The accelerated maturation process at Maison Lineti comes with an added bonus: fewer losses due to evaporation during the aging process. The angel's share", the portion of whisky that naturally disappears through the porous wood of the casks, is significantly reduced, allowing the distillers to retain a larger proportion of their product. Maison Linetti's innovative approach to whisky production relies heavily on data analysis and experimentation. The company collects vast amounts of information on every stage of the process, from brewing to fermentation. Excel files contain detailed records of each batch, with over 10,000 lines of data. The data collection is meticulous, with specific parameters monitored at regular intervals. For example, temperature and transfer yield are tracked during brewing, while time and temperature are recorded every 20 minutes during fermentation. This granular level of detail allows Cosculluela and Picard to isolate the effects of any changes made to the process. The data science underpinning Maison Linetti's operations is a key factor in its success. By adjusting one parameter at a time, the team can accurately assess the impact of each change and refine their techniques accordingly. This approach enables them to pinpoint improvements and make targeted adjustments. Maison Linetti has faced significant financial challenges, including a liquidity crisis last year when its main backer withdrew from the business. Despite this setback, the company managed to secure new investment from a French entrepreneur with a background in luxury goods. Maison Lineti's whisky has finally reached UK shelves after securing new investment from a French entrepreneur with a background in luxury goods. The company plans to expand its reach further by bringing its spirit to the US market in 2028. In preparation for this move, Maison Lineti has launched a core expression and two limited-edition whiskies as part of its initial range. These inaugural releases include Calibre No1, which is described as the DNA of the brand, evoking sophistication, complexity, and elegance through its unique characteristics. The limited editions, Complication No1 and Complication No2, showcase the distillery's innovative approach to whisky-making. Maison Lineti's innovative approach to whisky-making has opened up new possibilities for the distillery. They can experiment with different production methods, allowing for a wide range of flavor profiles, including creamy and fruity whiskies, as well as those with a malty character and a signature floral undertone. articles.title: Suspension of Constitutional Tribunal President Sparks Protests in Poland
articles.summary: Protests erupted in Poland as critics gathered outside the country's top court, expressing discontent over the suspension of its president by the Cabinet.
articles.content: Protests have erupted in Poland as government critics gather around the country's top court to express their discontent over the suspension of its president by the Cabinet. The protests turned violent when some demonstrators hurled objects at police officers and attempted to break through the security fence surrounding the tribunal building, prompting authorities to detain three protesters. The clashes between police and protesters highlighted the depth of public frustration with the government's actions. Meanwhile, Polish President Karol Nawrocki had been en route to Senegal on a diplomatic visit when he abruptly changed course due to the unfolding situation in Warsaw. Nawrocki declared his decision to return home through social media platform X, stating that as president, it was crucial for him to be present in Poland at this moment of crisis. Protests over the Constitutional Tribunal in Poland are expected to escalate tensions between the pro-European government and its national-conservative opponents. The main opposition party, Law and Justice (PiS), has been accused by critics of imposing political control over key judicial institutions. Critics within Poland and the European Union have long argued that PiS's reforms introduced during their tenure from 2015 to 2023 undermined the independence of the judiciary. As a result, the EU imposed fines on Poland for failing to comply with its rules. The current pro-European government, led by Prime Minister Donald Tusk, has faced repeated vetoes from two successive presidents aligned with PiS in its efforts to restore the independence of the judiciary. This includes the latest attempt to address the issue. The suspension of Constitutional Tribunal President Bogdan Święczkowski was announced on Friday evening via the tribunal's website. The decision sparked an immediate reaction from protesters, including PiS leader Jarosław Kaczyński and far-right politicians who gathered outside the building in protest. The Polish president's decision to suspend a judge has sparked widespread controversy, with politicians from various parties weighing in on the matter. Tusk's government has pledged to ensure that the tribunal is staffed with lawfully appointed judges, despite criticism from PiS politicians who see Święczkowski's suspension as an attack on the constitutional order. Former Justice Minister Zbigniew Ziobro described the move as a "blatant, criminal attack" and called for resistance against it. The situation remains tense, with protesters gathering outside the building to express their opposition to Tusk's decision. articles.title: Ebola Outbreak in Democratic Republic of Congo Surpasses 5,000 Deaths
articles.summary: At least 10,351 people have been infected with Ebola, resulting in almost 50% mortality rate.
articles.content: The Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 5,000 deaths in its ongoing Ebola outbreak, a grim milestone in the fight against the highly infectious and deadly virus. According to data from the Congolese Ministry of Health, at least 10,351 people have been infected with Ebola, resulting in a staggering almost 50% mortality rate. The rapid spread of the disease has left healthcare officials scrambling to contain its impact, sparking concerns among experts about the government's ability to manage the crisis. The current outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo virus strain, was declared in mid-May and caught authorities off guard, forcing them to adapt their response strategies on the fly. The sheer scale of the outbreak has put immense pressure on local healthcare systems, which are struggling to cope with the influx of patients. As the death toll continues to rise, international health organizations are sounding the alarm about the potential for Ebola to spread across the African continent, echoing fears expressed during a similar outbreak in West Africa between 2014 and 2016 that claimed over 11,000 lives. The Ebola outbreak in Congo has been marked by a significant number of cases and deaths. To date, 2,788 people have recovered from the virus, but the Bundibugyo strain has no known vaccine or treatment. However, health workers are treating patients based on symptoms, which has become a crucial aspect of managing the outbreak. The disease has spread to 67 out of the country's 178 health zones in eight of its 26 provinces since May. The eastern region of Congo has been particularly affected, with 9,782 total confirmed cases and 4,792 total deaths reported in Ituri and North Kivu provinces. These two regions have emerged as the epicenters of the outbreak. Tracing contacts and testing are essential components in the fight against Ebola, but authorities are struggling to keep up with these tasks, allowing a significant number of new cases to go undetected. The sheer scale of the Ebola outbreak in Congo is a major concern for health authorities, who are struggling to reach people early enough to provide them with a fighting chance at survival. The complexity of the situation is compounded by ongoing conflicts in the region, which have created a challenging environment for healthcare workers to operate effectively. In the eastern part of the country, government forces are engaged in a longstanding struggle against various armed groups, including the M23 rebel group backed by Rwanda, and an Islamist insurgency led by the Allied Democratic Forces along the border with Uganda. The presence of these conflicts has significantly hindered efforts to contain the outbreak, as healthcare workers face difficulties in accessing affected areas. Moreover, the population's widespread skepticism towards health measures has led to a series of attacks on medical personnel and facilities. This lack of trust has resulted in tragic incidents, such as the killing of a nurse who was responding to an Ebola alert last week, and the murder of a politician from the ruling party in September after he advocated for health measures on the radio. Health workers in the Democratic Republic of Congo have been forced to go on strike due to unpaid wages, causing disruptions at Ebola treatment centers across the country. The latest incident occurred on Friday at an Ebola treatment center in Tchomia, Ituri, where staff downed tools demanding four months' worth of outstanding salaries. The facility currently has five confirmed Ebola patients and 10 suspected cases under care. Workers are struggling to make ends meet, with one striking employee stating that being able to feed their families had become a significant problem. Similar situations have played out in other health zones, including Beni in North Kivu, where services at some treatment centers have effectively come to a standstill due to a lack of fuel and financial resources from the central government. An elected official in Beni has highlighted the dire situation, pointing out that cases are spiraling out of control as a result. The outbreak is putting immense pressure on responders, including local communities who are also being stretched to their limits. According to Rose Tchwenko, Country Director for the DRC, Prosper Global, this strain is evident across Ituri and North Kivu. The spread of Ebola continues to pose a significant threat to regional health authorities, with multiple countries now reporting cases. Kenya has confirmed eight cases of Ebola, resulting in two fatalities, while Nigeria reported its first case, which was subsequently evacuated to Switzerland for treatment. This development marks the first time Ebola has been detected in three African regions, making the current outbreak the most geographically widespread on the continent. The confirmation of cases in Kenya and Nigeria adds to concerns about a potential continent-wide spread of the disease, with Uganda already having reported cases earlier in the outbreak. articles.title: UK Government Considers Apology for Trans-Atlantic Slave Trade Role
articles.summary: The UK government has hinted at offering an apology for its historical involvement in the trans-Atlantic slave trade as part of efforts to strengthen ties with nations in Africa and the Caribbean.
articles.content: The UK government has hinted at a potential apology for its role in the trans-Atlantic slave trade as part of efforts to strengthen ties with nations in Africa and the Caribbean. UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham made this announcement while writing in The Guardian on Saturday, highlighting the need for Britain to confront its complex history. This move comes ahead of his visit to Antigua and Barbuda next week, where he will attend a meeting of Commonwealth leaders. Burnham emphasized that acknowledging the past is crucial for maintaining the integrity of the Commonwealth, an association of 56 independent nations formed from the remnants of the British Empire. He acknowledged that certain member states have long sought honest discussions about the legacy of slavery. The Prime Minister stated that by avoiding this conversation, the UK has inadvertently hindered the ability of the Commonwealth to function effectively. This realization has prompted the government to propose starting a structured dialogue with those affected by slavery. In response to calls for reparations, Burnham made it clear that Britain will continue to resist demands for compensation related to the slave trade. However, he did express willingness to listen to requests for a formal apology from the British state. The Prime Minister's stance on historical wrongs has sparked debate about accountability for past injustices. Burnham emphasized that current Britons cannot be held responsible for atrocities committed in a different era under varying laws and circumstances. He shifted focus towards addressing pressing issues affecting Commonwealth nations today, including the substantial debt burdens faced by many developing countries. The Prime Minister plans to collaborate with wealthy nations and investors to facilitate longer repayment periods and lower interest rates for vulnerable countries. Burnham announced that former Prime Minister Gordon Brown will attend the upcoming Commonwealth meeting to advance this initiative. Brown is a prominent advocate for debt relief in developing nations, and his participation aims to accelerate progress on this issue. The Commonwealth Heads of Government meeting will take place from Sunday through Wednesday in St. John's, the capital of Antigua and Barbuda. King Charles III faced demands for an apology and reparations during the initial phase of his Caribbean trip, which concludes with the meeting. The UK government's stance on apologizing for its role in the slave trade has been a contentious issue, with King Charles III facing demands for an apology and reparations during his Caribbean trip. This shift in policy may be influenced by Britain's efforts to strengthen ties with its Commonwealth allies amidst global economic, environmental, and military challenges. The government may also seek to address concerns from younger, more liberal voters who are calling for a re-examination of the UK's colonial history. In recent years, anti-racism protests have highlighted the legacy of British slave traders, including Edward Colston, an English merchant and politician who shipped thousands of enslaved people to colonies in the Americas. His statue was torn down by protesters in Bristol in 2020 as a symbol of opposition against glorifying the lives of those involved in the slave trade. The descendants of some individuals who profited from the slave trade have already apologized and offered compensation, including the owner of the Guardian newspaper. U.K. politicians have traditionally celebrated the country's role in banning the slave trade in 1807 and outlawing slavery throughout the British Empire in 1833. However, Burnham emphasized that it is time for a more nuanced understanding of the UK's involvement in the trans-Atlantic slave trade. He acknowledged that while Britain was at the forefront of abolishing slavery, its people also participated in the brutal trade of human lives. The acknowledgment by Burnham comes as part of a broader effort to confront and make amends for the country's complex past. articles.title: Breakthrough in Laboratory Research Using Artificial Intelligence Agent
articles.summary: Researchers at Exin Therapeutics have successfully used an artificial intelligence (AI) agent to inject drugs directly into a live mouse's brain.
articles.content: A breakthrough in laboratory research has been achieved by biotech founder Gabriel Ocana Santero, who successfully used an artificial intelligence (AI) agent to inject drugs directly into a live mouse's brain. This unprecedented feat showcases the potential for AI to become a hands-on participant in scientific experimentation. The experiment required some innovative problem-solving on the part of Santero and his team at Exin Therapeutics, a startup based in San Francisco that is harnessing AI to develop treatments for neurological disorders such as epilepsy and neurodegenerative diseases. By connecting an AI agent to a custom-built surgical setup, they were able to inject drugs into the mouse's brain with precision. Santero's interest in exploring the capabilities of AI agents lies in their ability to analyze vast amounts of scientific data and identify patterns that might elude human researchers. However, he notes that these models are typically trained on published literature alone, which can lead to incomplete understanding of the research process and its nuances. The integration of AI with real-world experiments is seen as a key step forward by Santero, who believes it will make his team's models more reliable and effective in identifying potential treatments for complex diseases. The team of researchers used a sophisticated rig to carry out the experiment, which included a motorized device to immobilize the mouse and a camera that enabled the AI agent to observe every step of the procedure. A veterinary surgeon first performed a craniotomy on the mouse while the AI agent watched, after which it was time for the agent to take control and guide the treatment to its target in the brain. The AI model had been asked to choose from 19 different options in a spreadsheet, including a gene therapy designed to reduce seizures in mice with epilepsy. The AI selected not only the therapy but also the specific brain region where it would be administered and the precise coordinates for the injection. It then controlled the robotic arms and injector needle, as well as all relevant parameters such as volume and speed of delivery. However, during one attempt, the AI model refused to guide the needle into the mouse's brain, citing an internal warning that could have serious consequences for the animal if it stopped midway through the procedure. The team subsequently switched to a different AI model, Claude Sonnet 5, which agreed to proceed with the injection and successfully carried out the task. Researchers have been working towards integrating AI into physical systems and have already started enlisting agents for various tasks in the real world. The team behind the brain injection experiment had put safeguards in place to ensure that the procedure was carried out safely, including requiring human approval of the injection plan and installing an emergency shutdown button. However, a technical issue arose when a glitch disrupted the equipment's coordinate system, causing the calculated injection position to be incorrect. The AI agent correctly identified the problem but refused to modify its own code to correct it, as this would have been in conflict with its original instructions. The team eventually resolved the issue by using another AI model, Opus 5, to make the necessary changes to the equipment's code without informing the agent that a live surgery was underway. The experiment's setbacks notwithstanding, Santero and his team were impressed by the AI agent's performance during the procedure. They are now waiting to see how the therapy affects seizures in the mouse before assessing its impact. A typical brain injection surgery usually takes about 45 minutes, but this experiment lasted slightly longer than an hour due to the back-and-forth between the human operator and the AI agent. The team is planning further tests with other models, including Grok, to determine which one performs better in similar scenarios. Santero emphasizes the importance of human oversight during experiments involving living animals, particularly when it comes to delicate procedures like brain surgery. The team's goal is to ensure that AI agents can work alongside humans safely and effectively. The company is also experimenting with more complex tasks, such as agent-controlled craniotomies, but only after they are confident in the safety of their systems. Santero believes that AI agents will increasingly collaborate with human scientists, with direct access to lab equipment, but for now, human supervision remains crucial. articles.title: Autumn Foliage at Omni Mount Washington Resort
articles.summary: Travel journalists often have their preferred destinations for experiencing autumn foliage, but one hotel stands out as particularly exceptional.
articles.content: Travel journalists often have their preferred destinations for experiencing autumn foliage, but one hotel stands out as particularly exceptional. Every year, I embark on a nearly six-hour drive from New York City to the White Mountains in New Hampshire, where the scenic route is rewarded with breathtaking views of red, orange, and yellow leaves blanketing the mountainside. The winding roads, narrow mountain passes, and quaint towns along the way create an immersive experience that feels like part of the vacation itself. As I arrive at Bretton Woods, a picturesque village nestled in the heart of New Hampshire's Presidential Range, I find myself at the doorstep of the historic Omni Mount Washington Resort. The sprawling lobby of the Omni Mount Washington Resort is a sight to behold, its grandeur tempered by a warm and inviting atmosphere that makes it feel like a home away from home. As I make my way through the lobby, I'm filled with anticipation for the leisurely activities that await me during my stay. Evenings spent cozied up by the outdoor firepits, surrounded by nature's vibrant hues, are just one of the many pleasures in store. The resort offers a wide range of activities to suit every interest and preference. Guests can tee off on one of the two golf courses, take a scenic gondola ride over the fall foliage, or opt for more leisurely pursuits like fly-fishing or horseback riding. My first order of business upon checking in is usually a visit to the expansive back veranda, which stretches an impressive 900 feet and offers breathtaking views of the Presidential Range and the resort's beautifully manicured grounds. The hotel's newest section, which opened in 2021, boasts an impressive array of guest rooms, totaling 69 in number, many of which come equipped with balconies and deep soaking tubs for a truly indulgent stay. Each room has been carefully designed to strike the perfect balance between cozy charm and refined elegance, as evident from the plaid wallpaper that adds warmth to the space. The oversized marble bathrooms are another standout feature, providing an oasis of tranquility within the guest rooms. One of the thoughtful touches that sets this hotel apart is the provision of bath salts alongside each tub, allowing guests to unwind after a day spent exploring the beautiful surroundings. For those staying in the Presidential Wing, access to the heated outdoor pool is also readily available, inviting a relaxing evening swim under the starry night sky. The resort's culinary offerings cater to diverse tastes and preferences, with several dining options to choose from. Stickney’s, a cozy steakhouse, serves up an array of dishes, including seafood and steaks, while Fabyan’s Station, housed in a restored historic train depot near the ski area, offers a more casual meal experience. The resort's location in the White Mountains provides a unique backdrop for exploring some of New Hampshire's most spectacular fall scenery. The area is home to numerous hiking trails and scenic drives, offering breathtaking views of the changing foliage. For those looking to experience the region's natural beauty from a different perspective, Crawford Notch and Franconia Notch are nearby attractions that showcase the state's stunning landscapes. In addition to its natural surroundings, the resort itself hosts various events, including lectures on astronomy, such as "Cosmos in The Cave." This intimate setting provides an ideal space for guests to unwind and socialize. For those seeking a more relaxed atmosphere, Fabyan's Station offers casual dining options in a restored historic train depot near the ski area. The Omni Mount Washington is situated within proximity to several charming towns in north-central New Hampshire, including North Conway and Jackson. Each of these towns has its own unique character and attractions, making them worth visiting during a stay at the resort. In October, Jackson hosts an annual Pumpkin People celebration, where local businesses create intricate pumpkin-head displays throughout the village. The area's natural beauty and charming towns make it an ideal destination for visitors seeking to experience New England's fall foliage. With its rich history, stunning landscapes, and quaint villages, the region has something to offer every type of traveler. The Omni Mount Washington Resort provides a comfortable and convenient base from which to explore these attractions. The Omni Mount Washington Resort offers a unique blend of grandeur and convenience, making it an ideal base for exploring the region's fall foliage. Staying at this resort allows guests to balance outdoor adventure with luxury, providing a seamless transition from hiking through charming towns to relaxing in a room equipped with a soaking tub and breathtaking views. The property's historic charm is complemented by modern amenities, creating a truly unforgettable experience. The resort's combination of history, grandeur, and access to nature makes it an attractive destination for those planning an autumn trip to New England, as the surrounding mountains feel like part of the experience even when indoors. This unique blend has made the Omni Mount Washington Resort a favorite among travelers seeking a quintessential fall getaway. articles.title: Youth Olympics Underway in Dakar Senegal
articles.summary: The 2026 Youth Olympic Games are underway in Dakar, Senegal, with over 2,700 young athletes competing in various sports through November 13th.
articles.content: The 2026 Youth Olympic Games are underway in Dakar, Senegal, marking a historic moment for Africa as it hosts its first-ever Olympics on the continent. The event is part of Africa's efforts to increase its presence in international sporting competitions. About 2,700 young athletes from around the world will compete in various sports through November 13th in Dakar and nearby cities Diamniadio and Saly. This diverse group ranges in age from 14 to 17 years old and represents a broad spectrum of global youth talent. The opening ceremony featured hundreds of dancers showcasing Senegalese and African culture, aligning with the "Africa Welcomes motto of the International Olympic Committee's Fames program. This cultural celebration was designed to highlight the unique heritage and traditions of the region. According to local residents, this event is seen as a significant opportunity for Senegal and Africa to engage with international youth athletes and experience new sports firsthand. The opening ceremony of Africa's first-ever Youth Olympic Games is set to take place in Dakar, Senegal, with a star-studded lineup expected to attend. French actor Omar Sy, who has roots in Senegal and stars in the Netflix series Lupin, is among those scheduled to appear. Sy will be joined by Senegalese Italian TikTok sensation Khaby Lame, both of whom serve as ambassadors for the games. The two celebrities are expected to bring a touch of glamour to the ceremony, which promises to showcase the best of African talent and culture. The games' mascot, Ayo, is a young lion donning a traditional Fulani hat, reflecting the rich cultural heritage of West Africa. The name Ayo" means "joy" in Yoruba, spoken by millions in Nigeria and neighboring countries. In a few hours, President Bassirou Diomaye Faye will declare the games open at 6:30pm local time (0830 GMT) at the Diamniadio stadium. He will be joined by International Olympic Committee President Kirsty Coventry and several heads of state, all of whom are expected to be present for the historic occasion. The Youth Olympics offer a unique platform for young athletes from around the world to compete in 153 medal events across 25 sports, including athletics, swimming, and basketball. Several new sports will make their debut at the games, including Baseball5, Wushu, coastal rowing beach sprint, and beach wrestling, which pays homage to Senegalese wrestling. The inaugural Youth Olympic Games hosted by Senegal will feature a historic first: a refugee team competing in track and field, judo, and taekwondo events. The six-athlete team is based in Kenya and Uganda. This milestone marks the 130th anniversary of the modern Olympics' debut in Athens, Greece. In a significant development for African sports, Zimbabwean Coventry was elected as the IOC's first African president last year - also marking a historic achievement for women in leadership roles at the organization. African countries are increasingly leveraging sport as a tool for diplomacy and development. Frédéric Sohoundé, a Dakar-based sports analyst, observes that investments in sports infrastructure by nations like Morocco have contributed to their ability to attract repeated competitions. Morocco's investment strategy has paid off, with the country hosting several high-profile events. However, Senegal faces challenges in maintaining its venues after the games. Frédéric Sohoundé notes that reliable maintenance funding and regular events are crucial to prevent newly built facilities from becoming expensive white elephants. The International Olympic Committee's shift in approach under Coventry's leadership is evident in its decision to host the Youth Olympic Games in Senegal, a move that some see as a trial run for Russia's potential return at the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics. Senegal's hosting of the games comes amidst a significant debt crisis and growing public discontent over rising living costs. The country's authorities are struggling to make ends meet due to billions of dollars in unreported debt left behind by the previous administration, which has led to layoffs and fuelled protests in recent months. Many Senegalese citizens have expressed frustration at being forced to prioritize their daily needs over attending the sporting events. A government-led foundation drew criticism for announcing a contribution of 500 million CFA francs (approximately $854,000) to purchase tickets for school children, with some questioning the source of this funding. This criticism is coming from several Democratic nominees who are seeking to distance themselves from the incumbent president and neutralize a potential political vulnerability. In Texas, James Talarico, the Democratic Senate nominee, has been airing ads criticizing Biden for failing to effectively manage border security. Talarico's criticism of Biden on border policy is not an isolated incident; in fact, it reflects a broader trend among Democrats who are seeking to address voter concerns about immigration and national security. In his own words, Talarico described Biden's handling of the southern border as "a disaster. In Kansas, another key battleground state, Democratic nominee Adam Hamilton echoed similar sentiments during a recent debate with Republican Sen. Roger Marshall, stating that immigration under Biden was a major contributor to the current situation at the border. Criticism of President Biden's handling of the border issue is not limited to Republicans. Some Democrats in key battleground areas are also expressing discontent, albeit for different reasons. They argue that the current president has taken a too-aggressive approach on enforcement. Polls indicate that many Americans have lost faith in Trump's immigration policies following high-profile incidents involving the fatal shooting of civilians by border patrol officers this year. Despite this shift in public opinion, Democrats are struggling to distance themselves from accusations of promoting open borders. The issue of border security remains a liability for Democrats as they face criticism from Republicans who aim to galvanize their base and attract swing voters. Biden's ratings on the matter plummeted during his presidency due to a significant surge in migrant crossings. This influx of migrants was partly attributed to Biden's decision to relax Trump-era policies, allowing more asylum seekers to remain in the country while their cases were being processed. As a result, border crossings skyrocketed and became closely associated with the Biden presidency, ultimately contributing to a decline in his approval ratings. The issue of border security continues to be a contentious topic in American politics, despite President Biden's efforts to address it. Democratic candidates are increasingly distancing themselves from the administration on this issue, with some even criticizing its handling of the situation. At a recent debate, Paige Cognetti, a Democratic House candidate, stated bluntly that the Biden administration failed at the border." She emphasized the need for secure borders and expressed support for measures to ensure they remain secure. Celinda Lake, a prominent Democratic pollster, believes it's a wise strategic move for candidates to distance themselves from the president on this issue. She notes that immigration was a major concern for swing voters in the 2024 election, one that energized Republican supporters. In key battleground states, some Democrats are distancing themselves from President Joe Biden's handling of the border crisis. articles.title: Ukrainian War Veterans Compete in International Fitness Competition in Spain
articles.summary: A group of Ukrainian war veterans have taken part in an international fitness competition in Valencia, Spain, as part of their recovery from combat injuries.
articles.content: Ukrainian war veterans have taken on a challenging fitness competition in Valencia, Spain, as part of their recovery from combat injuries. Dmytro Bykhovchenko, who lost both legs in action, has become a meticulous planner since his injury, working out every detail of his daily routine to ensure accessibility and ease of movement. This includes planning the best routes for trips, arranging for cars with ramps or handrails, and anticipating any potential obstacles. Bykhovchenko recently completed his most ambitious plan yet by participating in an international fitness competition known as HYROX, which combines eight 1-kilometer runs with eight intense workouts involving sled pushes, rowing, weighted carries, and sandbag lunges. The event's disabled category included amputee athletes. Bykhovchenko finished the course using a wheelchair to navigate around the track and completing floor-based exercises as planned. He attributed his participation in the competition to its positive impact on his mental and emotional well-being, saying that sport helps him cope with the challenges he faces. Bykhovchenko's participation in the international race was a testament to his resilience and determination, considering he lost both legs three years ago during the intense fighting at Avdiivka. The Russian drone attack had dropped an explosive into his trench, causing significant damage and delaying his evacuation for hours. The team's performance marked a milestone in their recovery, not just physically but also emotionally. Their presence at the event sent a powerful message about Ukraine's ongoing struggle against more than 4 and a half years of war. It was a beacon of hope amidst the turmoil. Oleh Tserkovnyy, an endurance athlete and team member, emphasized the significance of their participation. "It means a lot to be here and show the world what a veteran of the Russia-Ukraine war is," he said. The team aimed to inspire others with their actions, highlighting the strength and determination that defined them. Some team members were relatively new to sports, relying on volunteer trainers who dedicated hours to help them prepare for the competition. Yasia Shandrii, a fitness trainer in Kyiv, had worked closely with Bykhovchenko ahead of the event, providing crucial support as he trained for the circuits. The amputee athletes from Ukraine have a diverse range of injuries, including double lower-limb amputations, single-leg amputations, high arm amputations, and below-the-knee amputations. For some, participating in sports provides an escape from the constant reminders of war. Oleksandr Dashko, who lost his left leg due to a combat injury, says that engaging in physical activity helps him forget about the conflict. He notes that every interaction with friends is now centered around the war and its aftermath, making it difficult to disconnect. Through their determination and hard work, these athletes are able to put aside their struggles for a few hours each day, finding solace in the mental clarity that comes from pushing themselves physically. However, instead of being let go, the United hierarchy granted him a stay of execution, though his long-term future remains uncertain. Despite the mounting scrutiny surrounding his tenure, Carrick insists he is fully aware of the stakes but remains unfazed by external commentary. Michael Carrick's unwavering commitment to his role as Manchester United manager was evident in his statement to the media on Thursday. articles.title: Bolsonaro Fled Brazil Amid Persecution Claims
articles.summary: Flavio Bolsonaro sparked controversy by posting a video message on social media claiming he fled the country due to persecution after losing the presidential election runoff to Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva.
articles.content: Brazilian senator Flavio Bolsonaro has sparked controversy by posting a video message on social media claiming he fled the country due to persecution. The right-wing politician made the announcement late Friday, just days after losing the presidential election runoff to Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva. Bolsonaro's decision to leave Brazil was reportedly taken in secret and involved traveling through several countries before arriving in Florida. According to his statement, he departed on Tuesday and arrived at a US airport on Wednesday after passing through Argentina and Ecuador. The senator claimed that the persecution began earlier than he had anticipated, referencing the revocation of his Brazilian passports as part of an ongoing money laundering investigation. His statements were made during an Instagram livestream in which he discussed his decision to leave Brazil. Bolsonaro's father, former president Jair Bolsonaro, is currently under house arrest and was visited by Flavio on Monday before being informed that his son's passports would be seized by police. Flavio Bolsonaro's video statement has shed light on his decision to leave Brazil, citing what he perceives as persecution. The senator expressed his concerns to his father, who was visibly emotional during their conversation. In a poignant exchange, Flavio revealed that he and his wife made the decision to depart without informing anyone else. He urged people not to "point the finger at anyone," implying that those involved in his escape should remain anonymous. Flavio's comments have sparked controversy, with pressure mounting on US President Donald Trump and Argentine President Javier Milei to clarify their roles in the senator's departure from Brazil. Flavio also accused Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes of making false accusations against him. Flavio Bolsonaro has made several allegations about irregularities in the Brazilian election process, drawing a comparison between them and "handball goals that were not disallowed by VAR. He also predicted economic turmoil under President-elect Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's administration, saying that the economy would go bust. Brazil's government has summoned Argentina's representative in the country to explain why Bolsonaro was allowed to pass through Argentina on his way to Miami. This move comes after a diplomatic source revealed that Bolsonaro had traveled to the US via Argentina following his departure from Brazil. The tense relations between South America's two powerhouses have been further strained by this incident, which has raised questions about cooperation and diplomacy in the region. The Brazilian foreign ministry requested explanations on Thursday afternoon, highlighting the importance of understanding the circumstances surrounding Bolsonaro's journey. Milei's stance on the recent presidential election has also contributed to the deteriorating relationship between Argentina and Brazil. As one of the few Trump allies who refused to congratulate Lula on his win, Milei's actions have set him apart from other politicians in the region who quickly acknowledged the results of the election. The strained relationship between Argentina and Brazil is not a new development, with previous incidents having taken place under both Milei and Lula's leadership. The latest diplomatic spat follows a July incident when Brazil recalled its ambassador to Argentina after Milei made derogatory comments about Brazilian officials while in the country. Brazil's diplomatic relations with Argentina have taken a hit after a series of inflammatory comments made by far-right presidential candidate Javier Milei during his visit to Sao Paulo. Milei targeted Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva, labeling him a thief" and "delinquent," among other derogatory terms. Argentina has followed Brazil's lead in recalling its ambassador from the neighboring country. However, instead of recalling their top diplomat, both countries have opted for chargés d'affaires to represent their interests. The Brazilian government claims that by rescuing Bolsonaro from alleged communist persecution, they have safeguarded his freedom and that of other opposition figures.
